prompts.wayfarers: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT this sprite animation atlas, preserving exactly its ten rows by ten columns, all ten identities, pixel style, colours, transparency, frame positions and poses. Fix only physical hand-to-item connections in EVERY frame. Row 1 woman Ysra must actually hold her round shield: add the correct single forearm and visible hand gripping the shield handle behind/along its inner edge, shield strapped to that forearm, while the other hand firmly grips her spear shaft. Never float the shield beside her. Row 2 grey-haired swordsman Garran must actually grasp the sword hilt with one anatomically connected hand in ALL idle/walk/attack/hurt poses: blade emerges from guard, guard connects to hilt held in his hand, hand connected to wrist and arm. Sword must not float above or beside hand. Check and repair all other eight rows too: spear, axe, sword, bow, staff, mace, lantern, shield, rope and pick must be gripped by visible hands with connected wrists and arms. One hand per arm, no extra hands/limbs, don't fuse blades to palms, don't move equipment into an unrelated character. Shield supporting hand stays behind the shield, weapon hand grips hilt, bows by grip. Maintain practical gear, exactly the same poses and foot baselines, ten columns of idle2/walk4/action3/hurt1. No new props, no text, no grid, transparent background. This is a grip-correction pass, not a redesign.
prompts.watch: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct hand/weapon attachments ONLY in this 10-row by 10-column transparent medieval pixel sprite atlas. Keep the same ten characters, identities, palette, armour, weapons, all frame positions, same exact atlas dimensions, all existing foot baselines and animations. Row 1 Captain Vessa and row 4 Rolf: every sword must have a visible iron guard and hilt grasped by a single closed hand, attached to the wrist and forearm. No sword floating over an empty hand. Row 2 Ser Alden: his round shield must be actually carried on his other forearm with a leather strap and hand gripping the rear handle; spear hand holds the wooden shaft with connected wrist. Fix that for every idle, walking, attacking and hurt frame. All other characters must physically grasp their bow, staff, keys, halter, lantern, horn or supply roll; repair any gap between hand and handle or strap. Keep hands anatomically correct, no added limbs, no second hand at a single wrist. Maintain exactly ten frames per row: idle2 walk4 action3 hurt1, crimson hurt splashes only in final column. No text, no grid, no background, true transparency. Preserve the art style, don't redesign.
prompts.outlaws: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair physical hand-to-weapon connections in this existing 10-row x 10-column transparent pixel sprite atlas. Preserve exactly all ten identities, clothing, practical weapons, poses, cell layout, canvas size, colours, pixel style and transparent background. In row 5 Ulric, his shield must be visibly strapped to his off-hand forearm, with that hand gripping the rear handle, the wrist and elbow anatomically connected. The other hand firmly wraps the sword HILT immediately behind its guard, not the blade. Check all ten rows in all ten frames for floating swords, axe heads, clubs, spear shafts, bows and shields: connect each held object through a visible grip/handle to the correct single hand and wrist. No detached weapons, no extra hands or limbs, no double weapons. Keep attack anticipation, impact, recovery frames and crimson hurt last frame. Don't change poses except the minimal hand/forearm corrections required to make the grips believable. No new props, no text or grid. True alpha.
prompts.ruinGate: Use case: stylized-concept. New production game sprite, an OPEN RUIN GATE. Reference image is for the existing stone arch's grey stone palette, simple artsy pixel style and straight front-facing x/y plane. Create a believable ruined medieval stone arch with TWO substantial weathered oak door leaves attached to the sides by visible black iron hinges, BOTH OPEN about 65 degrees, revealing a narrow walk-through gap between them. Doors clearly have thick plank boards, cross braces, iron handles and broken edges; actually attached at the jambs. Old moss on stones, a few chips. No gold, no ornament, no stone floor foreground. Front facing upright cutaway sprite, symmetrical roughly square composition, upper stones rounded arch, foot threshold aligned at bottom. The open timber leaves must occupy much of the former empty hole so the doorway reads as an actual open gate, rather than an empty stone arch. Medium pixel detail at about 160px native sprite height enlarged cleanly, crisp dark outline, readable large material clusters, consistent with reference, not photoreal. Transparent background AND transparent walk-through center, no black rectangle behind it, no checkerboard. Isolated full gate, generous transparent border on all four sides. No extra objects, no text, no grid.
